about: Every file type the app knows, in one place. Both ends load it: the server through server/stilo/modules/file_types, the browser through app/modules/file-types/model/builtin-types.js, which tools/protocol-sync.mjs writes from this file (never edit that copy). A name's type is the one whose extension is the longest match, so 'aria.persona.skill' is a character and 'notes.skill' a plain skill file. 'format' says how the file is edited, highlighted and previewed. Extensions add their own types in extensions/<name>/extension.json ('fileTypes'); both ends merge them after these.

reserved.about: Names no file or folder may have at a workspace's top, compared as a disk that ignores case and Unicode look-alikes would (both ends fold them the same way): the server keeps its own files there under these names (the tree, who may open it, the comments, the Agent's threads, each account's open files, a write in progress, the chats' database), and a local folder its manifest. Both ends refuse them (Workspace); a server test checks this list holds every name a module keeps in a project's folder that is a known type.
